constitutional_basis: Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control. Bench prototype is the 'experiment' slot of the loop. Until this is built and run, the package is PROTOTYPE_READY, not VALIDATED.

v0_bench_prototype.purpose: Reproduce simulator findings on physical hardware. Falsify (or confirm) the graceful-degradation claim under controlled occlusion.
components: 4x Sensirion SLF3S-0600F liquid flow sensors (or Bronkhorst mini-CORI-FLOW for higher accuracy)
4x Takasago RK-1 pinch valves (variable orifice via pinching silicone tubing)
1x peristaltic pump (CSF production simulator, 0.30 mL/min constant)
1x Arduino Mega or Raspberry Pi (controller, runs Python reference impl)
1x adjustable hydraulic resistor per segment (simulates lesion — screw clamp)
v0_bench_prototype.geometry: Proximal reservoir -> pump -> manifold -> 4 parallel branches (each: flow sensor -> pinch valve -> variable resistor -> distal reservoir)
v0_bench_prototype.instrumentation: All sensors logged at 10 Hz. Valve commands logged at 1 Hz.

v0_test_scenarios.name: Healthy baseline (no occlusion)
v0_test_scenarios.method: Run 24 hours with no adjustable resistor change. Verify P_ICP stable at 12, F_i balanced.
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: P_ICP in [11, 13] for 100% of run. INV-2 holds. No isolations.

v0_test_scenarios.name: Mild failure (1/4 progressive occlusion)
v0_test_scenarios.method: Slowly close resistor on segment 1 over 8 hours (mimics slow lesion).
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: INV-2 holds. P_ICP peak <= 22 mmHg. Predictor isolates segment 1 within 60 min of lesion onset. System survives 24 hours.

v0_test_scenarios.name: Adversarial failure (2/4 progressive occlusion)
v0_test_scenarios.method: Slowly close resistors on segments 1 and 2 over 8 hours, staggered by 4 hours.
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: INV-2 holds. P_ICP peak <= 25 mmHg. Both failing segments isolated within 60 min of their respective lesion onsets. System survives 24 hours.

v0_test_scenarios.name: Catastrophic failure (4/4 simultaneous occlusion)
v0_test_scenarios.method: Close all 4 resistors simultaneously over 2 hours.
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: System enters FAIL-SAFE (all valves open, P_ICP rises to physical ceiling). No INV-2 violation. Patient-equivalent would require emergency revision — same as current standard of care.

v0_test_scenarios.name: Sensor failure
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: Controller detects sensor failure (NaN readings), enters FAIL-SAFE (passive drainage mode).

v0_test_scenarios.name: Actuator failure
v0_test_scenarios.pass_criterion: Controller detects valve stuck (commanded alpha != observed conductance change), isolates segment 2.

v1_implantable_prototype.purpose: Pre-clinical prototype for chronic animal model.
key_differences_from_v0: Implantable-grade pressure sensor (Codman MicroSensor or equivalent)
Implantable flow sensor (NO COMMERCIAL OPTION — must develop)
blocking_unknowns: No chronic implantable CSF flow sensor exists. This is the SINGLE BIGGEST engineering risk. Options: (a) develop custom ultrasonic flow sensor, (b) infer flow from pressure drop across known resistance, (c) eliminate per-segment flow sensing and rely on pressure-only control (degraded performance).

what_must_be_true_before_v1_build_starts: V0 bench prototype demonstrates graceful degradation matches simulator prediction (+/- 2 mmHg on P_ICP peak)
Implantable flow sensor solution selected (custom, inferred, or eliminated)
Biocompatibility testing plan approved by IACUC
